newsitem.title: UK: FirstBus makes offer for Southampton buses.
newsitem.headline: FirstBus makes offer for Southampton buses.

text.p: British public transport company FirstBus Plc said on Tuesday it had made an indicative offer to acquire the entire share capital of Southampton Citybus which has turnover of around 12 million stg.
Southampton Citybus is wholly owned by its 420 employees and directors following an employee buyout from municipal ownership in 1993. It operates a fleet of 160 buses.

No further details of any response to the offer were given by FirstBus, which on Friday was told by the Department of Trade and Industry to divest some its Scottish bus assets following a monopolies enquiry into its 1996 purchase of a Glasgow bus firm.
